subject.title: fix(file-transfer): expand Windows-style tilde policy globs

question: Should OpenClaw accept `~\...` as an active home-relative file-transfer policy prefix for existing configs after upgrade?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it changes how existing file-access policy strings are interpreted, including allowlist entries that previously did not match.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Land the narrow helper change after the contributor posts redacted live Windows file-transfer proof for both allow and deny behavior.

options.title: Require an explicit compatibility note
options.body: Ask for PR-body release-note context or docs wording that clearly calls out the changed interpretation for existing `~\...` policy entries.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it until maintainers decide that existing `~\...` allow entries should remain inert for compatibility.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Land the narrow helper change after the contributor posts redacted live Windows file-transfer proof for both allow and deny behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The local history points to this person for the original file-transfer policy implementation and recent file-transfer fixes.
